prompt:
Create THIS specific legendary playable GOD — not a human, not a human in costume, not a powerful human. This is an EXTRADIMENSIONAL DIVINE BEING whose body IS the manifestation of ancient asgardian law. Ancient humans saw Allfather dimly and tried to copy what they saw as myth — Allfather is the SOURCE, not the copy.

GOD: Allfather. Male. Faction: Asgardian. Realm: The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds. Role: Defender.

MYTHOLOGICAL SOURCES — deeply integrated into anatomy, not worn as accessories:

1. ODIN — The All-Father, Sovereign Who Traded an Eye for Wisdom
   - Ancient humans saw his single burning eye and copied it as a one-eyed god. His face is NOT human: one eye is a BURNING RUNE-LENS — a divine optical organ that sees across all battlefield timelines. The OTHER eye socket is SEALED with living obsidian — not an empty wound, but a SCAR THAT SEES DIFFERENTLY, showing him what the rune-lens cannot. His brow is HEAVY, predatory, crowned by BROKEN HORN-PRONGS that grow from his skull, not worn.
2. RAVENS — Huginn and Muninn, Thought and Memory
   - The ravens humans saw are NOT pets — they are LIVING DIVINE EXTENSIONS of his consciousness, perched on his shoulders as THOUGHT-CROWS made of storm-shadow and rune-light. They are part of his anatomy, growing from his shoulder-armor like living ornaments. When they spread their wings, they extend his battlefield awareness.
3. SOVEREIGN STORM — The Oath-Binder, War-King of the Aesir
   - His body is STORM-FORGED — dark rune-iron skin with oath-red wax veins that pulse with binding power. His shoulders carry OATH-STONE PAULDRONS — massive, rectangular, carved with rune-glyphs that glow when oaths are spoken. His chest is a RUNE-CHEST — visible oath-glyphs carved into his sternum, glowing through translucent iron skin.

NON-HUMAN ANATOMY — This being is unmistakably NOT human:
- Proportions are WRONG for a human: too tall, too precise, built at COLOSSAL scale. The camera looks UP at him/her. This is a DIVINE BEING that ancient humans tried to remember as a person.
- Skin is clearly not human: storm-root anatomy with rune scars cut like old wounds, iron-and-ash skin grain, frost-light joints, oath-ring growths, raven-shadow eyes, thunder moving in veins. It has a mineral, divine quality — energy patterns show THROUGH the skin as glowing channels, not painted on the surface.
- Face: one-eyed storm-king face: one living glacier-blue eye, one sacrificed dark socket veiled by a raven-shadow brow plate, broken hawk nose, deep cheek furrows, forked iron-gray beard, and no similarity to any other Asgardian A human could never wear this face — it is too clean, too precise, too symmetrical, as if carved from divine law.
- Body: elder-warrior Defender body: towering but not bodybuilder-generic, long cloak-backed torso, immense weathered hands, heavy protective forearms, narrower veteran hips, root-braced legs, and a permanent shield-wall lean shaped by centuries holding a Gate The proportions read as DIVINE, not mortal.
- Bare head — NO halo rings, NO discs, NO circles behind or around the head. The head is completely bare.
- Every element of the body must feel like it GREW from divine anatomy, not like it was PUT ON as costume.

WEAPON: Allfather Bulwark Rune-Iron Oath Axe
The weapon is made of the same divine material as the body — it looks like an EXTENSION of the deity, not a separate object. It is held with deliberate purpose, not generic combat posing. The weapon's silhouette must be unique to this deity and not shared by any other.

ARMOR (grown from divine body, not worn): Armor must use storm-iron mail, oath-ring collars, raven and wolf omen shapes, world-root veins, Valkyrie wing-weather, thunder scars, frost-giant mass, shield-wall geometry, ash wood, funeral flame, runes burned as physical wounds not UI glow.; construction proves source culture humans later copied as Norse myth; no cartoon Viking, generic horned helmet cosplay, clean chrome, sci-fi power armor.
asymmetric storm-iron mail built around a one-eyed oath-king: raven-feather shadow mantle over one shoulder, wolf-jaw guard on the opposite side, oath-ring collar, root-braced greaves, thunder scars burned into skin as old wounds, no horned cosplay helmet
Everything is BIOLOGY, not costume. Every plate, inlay, and marking must have a mythological reason for existing. No generic plate armor, no interchangeable faction gear.

MATERIALS (grown from divine body, not worn): primary: dark rune iron, storm steel, ash wood, wolf fur; secondary: raven feather shadow, oath red wax, bone white, blackwinter frost; accent: funeral ember, world-root bark
COLOR PALETTE: dark rune iron, storm steel, ash wood, wolf fur, raven feather shadow, oath red wax, bone white, blackwinter frost, funeral ember, world-root bark
Everything is BIOLOGY, not costume. Materials pulse with living energy — this is divine anatomy, not metalworked armor.

POSE: Three-quarter hero stance, face clearly visible, weapon clearly visible. Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm. shown through expression and gesture. Premium playable character presentation saying "this is a GOD you can unlock and command." The pose expresses the Defender role through readable tactical intent, not generic action posing.

SILHOUETTE: unmistakable Allfather silhouette: one-eyed high crown, raven-shoulder mantle on one side, wolf-jaw pauldron on the other, Yggdrasil root spine rising behind him, planted oath-axe crossing a bastion shield shape, readable even as a black icon The silhouette reads as a COLOSSAL DIVINE BEING, not a human warrior. Even in pure black silhouette, no one would mistake this for a human. Key silhouette markers: sovereign protector, gate-holder, law shield, source culture humans later copied as Norse myth, world-root bark.

ENVIRONMENT: The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds — extradimensional divine realm. Environments must show The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds as the source behind human mythic spaces, not a themed set.; Landmarks, weather, hazards, and sacred architecture physically shape movement. Cinematic lighting. Readable full-body focus. No clutter.

ART STYLE: Premium stylized-realistic 3D mythological fantasy character. NOT anime, NOT manga, NOT chibi, NOT photoreal, NOT generic AI fantasy, NOT sci-fi. This is a GOD — the first thing the viewer sees must be "that is NOT a human, that is a divine being." Living divine anatomy, not robotic, not blocky architecture. The non-human nature is the PRIMARY design directive, not an afterthought. AAA-quality game character concept for a premium mobile tactical RPG.

AVOID: cartoon Viking, generic horned helmet cosplay, clean chrome, sci-fi power armor, glowing UI runes, blocky hammer mech, modern biker leather, random Celtic knotwork.
